lines.text: The Emperor's favourite son set the galaxy on fire.
Horus Lupercal was the first primarch the Emperor ever found.
For decades they fought side by side, conquering world after world.
So when the Emperor went home to Terra, he gave Horus everything.
Then, on the moon of Davin, Horus was struck by a cursed blade.
As he lay dying, the Chaos gods showed him a future where his father was worshipped as a god, and Horus was forgotten.
Horus woke up a traitor, and half the Space Marine Legions followed him.
The war that followed nearly ended humanity.
Would you have followed him? Tell me in the comments.
